theme: A light calendar, with a few travel bookings past their dates.
greeting: The calendar's behind you for the day, Dan. What's left is a short stack of travel bookings that have gone overdue — the Christmas SUV and the December trip are the two worth clearing first.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Marked p1 and past due since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — book refundable now and adjust the dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and booking closes Oct 15 for all four girls over a three-week window — the thinnest holiday inventory of the year. Settle domestic vs. international and lock a shortlist.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The off-week gap to move the Pathfinder Portland → St Pete runs through Oct 18; after that it's closed until Christmas. Set dates and book the one hotel night.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley wants a morning time
flagged.detail: Scott Lazarus is waiting to confirm a call after the KPMG 401k thread; you offered 'anytime in the am.'

flagged.title: Signing reminder — St Pete Beach
